title: Stigmata man at a UFO conference

tellings.quote: And one guy had the stigmata.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells a podcast host about people he met at a UFO conference. Sherman says one man there had the stigmata, wounds like those of the crucified Jesus, which he mentions as one of the stranger things he saw on that circuit.
